leadText: Hazel VS Almond! (Japanese: マロンVSアーモンド!, VS Almond!) is the sixty-second chapter of Magical Pokémon Journey.
plainText:
Hazel VS Almond! (Japanese: マロンVSアーモンド!, VS Almond!) is the sixty-second chapter of Magical Pokémon Journey.

==Plot==
 
Grandpa's holding another contest. This time, it's to see who can find —if Ginger finds out he lost her precious Pokémon, she'll be furious! There are two possible prizes—a fishing rod and a Star Piece—so both Hazel and Almond are competing.

==Important characters and Pokémon==

Almond
Grandpa
